name: Axe of Famine

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus : +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls .

effects.name: Life-Devouring
effects.tooltip: Life-Devouring : This weapon deprives an enemy of its energy and passes it on to you. When you roll a 20 on an attack, the enemy must make a DC 28 Fortitude save or be subjected to a -6 penalty to all stats. At the same time you will feel your power return, as though Greater Restoration were cast on you. (Greater Restoration cures all temporary ability damage, restores all negative levels suffered from energy drain, and eliminates fatigue, exhaustion, confusion, and insanity suffered by you.)

effects.name: Strength Sapping
effects.tooltip: Strength Sapping : Every time this weapon deals damage, the target must succeed on a Fortitude save (DC 15) or become exhausted.

effects.name: Weakening
effects.tooltip: Weakening : This weapon drains the enemies' melee power. -1 Strength on a successful hit.

effects.name: Incite
effects.tooltip: Incite +15 : +15% Enhancement bonus to increased threat generation from melee damage

flavor_text: This weapon drives those it strikes mad with sensations of starvation, sapping their strength while simultaneously reversing damage to its wielder's body and mind.
